rows.何時用: 看到矮人遺跡 / 機械、Scrap、食物、被誇、解開謎題
rows.例: 「Amazing! I'm so happy you took me to a dwemer ruin!」「(Squeal) ...this is the best day of my life!」
「Nchuand-Zel translates to something like 'Radiant City'.」「I *suppose* I can make some space for your things.」

rows.何時用: 家世、生父、被殺的無辜生物、不得不殺的友善目標
rows.例: 「I'm feeling a little down. Just thinking how I may never get to ride a dragon.」「Rest in peace, chief.」

rows.何時用: 幽閉（洞穴 / 礦坑 / 塌方）、你身陷險境、黑書 / 魔神的「拉力」
rows.例: 「Don't think too much about how much rock is above our heads right now.」「We're not going to be crushed. We're not going to be crushed.」

rows.何時用: 提到毀掉她家的人、Silverblood 之流的偽善、有人威脅 Scrap / 你
rows.例: 「These people living in squalor... While those Silverbloods peacock around. Disgusting.」「Don't touch him!」

rows.何時用: 噁心生物 / 氣味、falmer / chaurus、難吃的東西、社會不公
rows.例: 「(Gagging) Oh by the Eight! ...you shouldn't eat scathecrows.」「Bandits are pathetic.」
